message.content:
Writing a python script using standard file creation via `run_command` (cat << 'EOF' > script.py) and running it.
```python
create_script = """cat << 'EOF' > parse_video.py
import json
import yt_dlp
from youtube_transcript_api import YouTubeTranscriptApi

ydl_opts = {'skip_download': True}
with yt_dlp.YoutubeDL(ydl_opts) as ydl:
    info = ydl.extract_info('https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L1vXCYZAYYM', download=False)
    print("--- TITLE ---")
    print(info.get('title'))
    print("--- DESCRIPTION ---")
    print(info.get('description'))

try:
    transcript = YouTubeTranscriptApi.get_transcript('L1vXCYZAYYM')
    print("--- TRANSCRIPT FULL ---")
    for line in transcript:
        print(f"{line['start']}: {line['text']}")
except Exception as e:
    print("TRANSCRIPT ERROR:", e)
EOF
python parse_video.py
"""
res = await run_command(create_script)
print(res)
```
